briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 -0.1%), but two names — RGC and BCE — showed full multi-signal confirmation including volume surges, so we used open slots and available cash to add them rather than waiting on an index-level signal.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Volume confirmation means checking that a price move is backed by higher-than-usual trading volume, which suggests real institutional interest rather than a random fluctuation. A price increase on heavy volume is considered more reliable than the same move on light volume.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 成交量確認是指留意股價變動是否伴隨著高於平常的成交量，這顯示有實質的機構資金參與，而非隨機波動。在大成交量下的升勢，通常被視為比低成交量下的同樣升勢更可靠。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially flat today, with the NASDAQ down 0.2% and the S&P 500 down 0.1%, reflecting a lack of major catalysts. Despite the quiet broad tape, individual stocks like RGC and BCE saw above-average volume and bullish technical crossovers, suggesting stock-specific buying interest rather than a market-wide trend. No major news events were available to explain today's moves.
market_education.summary_zh: 大市今日走勢平穩，納指微跌0.2%，標普500微跌0.1%，反映缺乏重大消息刺激。不過在大市平靜之際，RGC及BCE等個股錄得成交量明顯放大及技術指標轉強的現象，顯示資金正個別流入部分股份，而非廣泛的市場趨勢。今日未有重大新聞可解釋市況變動。

trades.reasoning: Full signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) indicates genuine institutional buying despite a neutral broad market.
Matches all four confirmation signals from past lessons (MACD crossover, bullish RSI zone, price above SMA-20, volume surge), a stock-specific setup independent of the flat index moves.
